name: Sucralose
what_it_is: Made from ordinary sugar, changed so the body passes it through. It is around 600 times sweeter.
why_its_added: Gives sweetness with almost no calories and without feeding the bacteria that cause tooth decay.

india.note: Maximum level depends on the food. Examples below.

eu.note: Statement on the validity of the conclusions of a mouse carcinogenicity study on sucralose (E 955) performed by the Ramazzini Institute

replaced_an_older_opinion.title: Safety of the proposed extension of use of sucralose -E 955- in foods for special medical purposes in young children

usa.note: Permitted as a food additive, subject to the conditions in this section (21 CFR 172.831)

safe_daily_limit.no_number_means: EFSA has not set a number for this one. That can mean it is considered safe enough not to need a limit, or that the evidence was not sufficient to set one. The opinion itself says which.

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.
